sources: Russia Defence Ministry Telegram + Dmytro Lubinets Facebook, via Reuters
fault_line: Humanitarian pause or propaganda stage? Zelenskyy warned Russia may try to discredit the process or stage propaganda from the evacuation (0600-01).

sections.what_happened: Both sides confirmed the Oleshky local ceasefire is in effect: Russia's Defence Ministry said on Telegram it stopped shelling toward Kherson from 04:00 Moscow time (01:00 GMT) to prepare the humanitarian operation; Ukraine's human-rights commissioner Dmytro Lubinets wrote on Facebook 'As head of the Ukrainian negotiating team, I confirm that the Ukrainian side is honoring its commitments.' Mathrubhumi (07:54 IST) adds the truce aims to aid ~2,000 trapped residents and holds through Saturday, possibly extendable. No ceasefire violation or aid-convoy movement reported in the first hours to 07:00 . Contrast: Kyiv took a second ballistic wave the same morning (0700-02) -- the truce is local to Oleshky, not a wider ceasefire.
sections.what_verified: Reuters; Mathrubhumi carries the same Reuters/AP line (not a distinct family)
sections.what_disputed: Russia's Monday claim that Ukraine struck Oleshky 18 times with artillery + 120+ drone attacks in the prior week (Reuters Oct 26, unverified, no Ukrainian response) hangs over the truce's durability.
sections.why_matters: Both sides now say it on the record: the Oleshky truce is holding its first hours -- while Kyiv burns the same morning. The contrast IS the story.
sections.context: Background: FOLLOW-UP to totw-20261027-0500-01/0600-01 -- Oleshky ceasefire mutually confirmed: Russia stopped shelling from 04:00 Moscow time, Ukraine's Lubinets confirms Kyiv honoring commitments; no violation reported in first hours
